children: Knowledge Economic City Company (KEC), Dar Al Majdiah Real Estate Co. (Al Majdiah) and Capital Hill Company have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to establish a closed-ended real estate investment fund to build a mixed-use project in Madinah.

The project, covering a development area of 97,000 square metres (sqm), will include around 2,700 residential apartments, a net leasable area of roughly 8,000 sqm and more than 3,500 parking spaces, KEC and Al Mahdiah said in statements to the Saudi stock exchange press.
The project’s estimated total cost is about 2.8 billion Saudi riyals ($746.25 million). KEC anticipates revenue exceeding SAR 4 billion and is primarily targeting non-Saudi Muslim buyers.
As part of the deal, KEC will contribute the project land as an in-kind contribution, while Al Majdiah will make a cash contribution and act as the investor and development manager.
Capital Hill will establish and manage the proposed fund.
KEC will hold approximately 80 percent of the fund, while Al Majdiah will hold the remaining 20 percent.

No details were given on when construction will start. The project is subject to completing regulatory conditions, with binding commercial obligations emerging only upon execution of the final agreements, the statements said.

title: Saudi developers co-launch $746mln mixed-use project in Madinah
